tasks.label: opencode: install dependencies
tasks.command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); chcp 65001 > $null; if ($env:BUN_LINKS_PATH -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:BUN_LINKS_PATH)) { $env:Path = $env:BUN_LINKS_PATH + ';' + $env:Path }; $winGetLinks = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Links'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $winGetLinks) { $env:Path = $winGetLinks + ';' + $env:Path }; if (Get-Command 'nvm' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { nvm use 24.11.1 }; $env:ELECTRON_MIRROR = 'https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/'; $env:npm_config_electron_mirror = 'https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/'; bun install; $electronVersion = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'packages\desktop\package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).devDependencies.electron; $electronPackage = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path 'node_modules' '.bun') -Directory -Filter ('electron@' + $electronVersion + '*') | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($electronPackage) { $electronInstall = Join-Path $electronPackage.FullName 'node_modules\electron\install.js'; $electronBinary = Join-Path $electronPackage.FullName 'node_modules\electron\dist\electron.exe'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $electronInstall) -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $electronBinary)) { bun $electronInstall }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $electronBinary)) { throw 'Electron binary is missing after install' } }
